A + 3 = D; B + 3 = E; C + 3 = F

D + 3 = G; E + 3 = H; F + 3 = I

G + 3 = J; H + 3 = K; I + 3 = L

J + 3 = M; K + 3 = N; L + 3 = O

Hence, GHI is the missing term.

L + 1 = M; M + 2 = O; N + 3 = Q

M + 1 = N; O + 2 = Q; Q + 3 = T

N + 1 = O; Q + 2 = S; T + 3 = W

O + 1 = P; S + 2 = U; W + 3 = Z

Hence, NQT is the missing term.

T + 2 = V; I - 2 = G; M + 2 = O; E - 2 = C

V + 2 = X; G - 2 = E; O + 2 = Q; C - 2 = A

X + 2 = Z; E - 2 = C; Q + 2 = S; A - 2 = Y

Z + 2 = B; C - 2 = A; S + 2 = U; Y - 2 = W

Hence, XEQA is the missing term.

questions.solution:
Four series:

P _ _ M _ _ J _ _ G _ _ D

X _ _ A _ _ D _ _ G _ _ J

F G _ I _ _ L _ _ _ P

A _ Y _ W _ U _ S

The number of letters in the word gets decreased by 1 in each step. First, the second letter from the left end is removed, then in next step, the second letter from the right end gets removed, and so on.
